description: This file defines classes and functions for parsing, serializing, and reconstructing Python traceback objects, including handling of traceback frames, code objects, and line cache management.

classes.name: Code
classes.description: Replicates essential parts of Python's Code object for serialization and traceback rendering.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Replicates essential parts of Python's Frame object for serialization and traceback rendering.

classes.name: LineCacheEntry
classes.description: Manages a list of lines from a source file, allowing setting specific lines.

classes.name: Traceback
classes.description: Wraps Python's Traceback object, enabling parsing, serialization, and conversion to actual traceback objects.

methods.name: populate_linecache
methods.description: Updates the linecache with lines from the traceback's cached lines.

methods.name: as_traceback
methods.description: Converts the custom Traceback object into a Python traceback object.

methods.name: as_dict
methods.description: Serializes the Traceback object into a dictionary for JSON serialization.

methods.name: from_dict
methods.description: Creates a Traceback instance from a dictionary.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Parses a string representation of a traceback into a Traceback object.
